run_calflow_generation: run the script to generate grammar-constrained CalFlow strings using a Mistral model

review_main: review the main function that loads a model, grammar, and generates constrained vs unconstrained outputs

test_grammar_validation: test that constrained generations match the EBNF grammar using StringRecognizer
